transition.evidence: A soft pass of air on the first frame of every ground flip; the circle reveal is the only full-frame change in this style.

stamp.evidence: One weighted impact when a black stamp lands, a block is crossed out or a layer drops.

swap.evidence: A small pop for a link line, a cable, an arrow or the morph of shapes into one.

click.evidence: The follow button tap: a click and the Following chime.

count.evidence: The counter stopping with its check and the follow tally changing.

reveal.evidence: A card landing or an item arrival the author marked as sounded; words, entrances and the narrator stay silent.

type.evidence: A code line or a command being typed inside a card.
